prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create an ultra-high-definition 9:16 high-fashion beauty cover portrait of a generic adult woman with a serene dreamy gaze and soft parted lips. Use an 85mm prime lens in a tight close-up, a 45-degree lateral head tilt, creamy f/1.8 bokeh and sharp focus on iris and eyelashes. Render realistic pores, natural freckles, matte skin, subtle pink-nude glossy lipstick and earth-tone eyeshadow. Her light hair is styled in a soft elegant messy updo with windswept movement, individual wispy strands catching warm rim light. She wears an opaque avant-garde off-white lace evening gown with floral embroidery, tailored form-fitting silhouette across the shoulders and refined neckline. Use muted pastels, cream and natural skin tones, softbox three-point studio lighting, warm rim lighting, professional color grading and subtle film grain. Preserve editorial beauty intent without reproducing any public-figure likeness.
